description: Controlled single-seed 50000-round five-step TD-target ablation against the matching Task 2 V3.5 one-step experiment. It changes only the TD target from the backward-compatible one-step SARSA target to the sampled five-step target sum(k=0..4, gamma^k * R[t+k+1]) + gamma^5 * Q(S[t+5], A[t+5]). If a round terminates within the five-step window, the return is truncated at the terminal reward and contains no bootstrap term. The five-step horizon includes the fixed timer-4 bomb explosion outcome in the original bomb-placement transition while preserving exactly one Q-update per transition. Feature representation, reward V3.5, action space, visit-decay learning rate, epsilon schedule, gamma, checkpoint interval, seeds, training duration, and evaluation protocol are unchanged.
